_readme: The balance guard's baseline (tests/balance-guard.mjs, 30-plan section E). Re-written only by --write --why, by the lane that moved a number.

pins.cutRows: rows a cut or dark lever carries (G14: a count over its pin is red). cost: a reference account's day (G16: 5% over is red). values: every line's numbers when written (the report prints what moved).
why: G16 ledger rows re-pinned, cause MEASURED (per-player-cost --only, ledger by kind, on archived trees): lane/c-tohit-ratio 2398754cb (to-hit as a ratio, rows re-authored) makes the Level 10 lone Thicket hero use supplies in 7 of 12 windows (was 4) and the Sewer four in 13 of 48 hero-windows (was 11); its parent 2398754cb^ reads 48 / 44.3, the commit 57 / 45.8. The rows are hunt supply_own, already ONE row a hero a save (meta.items batches every item), the journal of supplies destroyed (CLAUDE.md 1); combat accrue is unchanged at one a save. Worth it: no writer journals per item, and 1047-hourly-journal folds both shapes to one row a hero an hour after 180 min, so retained rows do not grow. The cut left is merging supply_own into hr_apply's accrue row (an economy-journal change across hr_apply and every restated apply_member body), not made here. Every other line's value re-read on this tree (set/v0.2.144 c5eb0ad1d + lane/a-ci-reds-144); the moves since 7392474f8 are in run 44979114749's MOVED lines.
